---
name: Community recipe
about: Share a family dish, a cooking tradition or an adaptation in your own words.
---

## Dish and cooking style

What do you call this dish? Which tradition, region or technique would you file it under? A new style is welcome.

## Ingredients and servings

Give amounts, yield and preparation time. Note any swaps you have actually cooked.

## Method

Describe the steps and the signs that tell the cook when it is ready.

## Credit or story

Share where you learned the dish or how you adapted it. Use your own wording and only include names you have permission to publish.

## Research (optional)

If you make a health claim, link the human research or food composition record that supports it. A family recipe needs no health claim.
